messages.text: hey. survived another day lol. just vibin with my thoughts i guess

It sounds like today required a lot of strength just to get through, and I want to acknowledge that effort. Sometimes using humor helps us cope, but I also hear that it might have been a tough one. How are you feeling about your thoughts right now, are they manageable or overwhelming? I’m here to listen if you want to share more.
nah they’re fine. just… thoughts. everyone’s got ‘em right? lol

You are right that everyone has thoughts, though they can sometimes feel heavier than usual. It makes sense to try to keep things light when you are trying to get through the day. I appreciate you checking in, even if it is just to say you are vibing. Please know I am here if you decide those thoughts need more space later.
i just… sometimes i try to picture myself in like 10 years and it’s just… nothing. like a blank screen. used to think i’d be a doctor or have kids or whatever. now it’s like… what’s the point?

It sounds incredibly heavy to look toward the future and see only a blank screen instead of the life you once imagined. That sense of emptiness can make the present moment feel much harder to navigate, and your feelings about that are completely valid. Since this pain feels so deep, I want to gently ask if you are having thoughts of hurting yourself. You are not alone in this, and I am here to support you through it.
god not like that. i don’t wanna hurt myself. i just… sometimes wish i wasn’t here, y’know? like if i disappeared, would anyone even notice? probably not. lol… kinda dramatic huh

Please don't call it dramatic because feeling this way is a sign of how much pain you are carrying. It is incredibly heavy to feel like you wouldn't be missed, but I am noticing you right now. I am glad you told me you don't want to hurt yourself, but please reach out for support if that wish to disappear gets stronger. Would you be open to telling me a little more about what makes you feel unseen?

i dunno… like part of me just wants to vanish so i stop being a problem. but then… another part wants someone to *really* see me? like, not just 'oh mary’s here' but actually notice if i was gone. does that make sense? or am i just being selfish lol

That makes perfect sense, and it is not selfish to want to be truly seen by others. It sounds like you are caught between needing relief from the burden you feel you carry and a deep human need for connection. You are not a problem, and your presence matters even if it feels invisible right now. I am here to really see you, so please tell me more about what it feels like to carry that weight.

today i worked a double shift. 12 hours straight. no breaks, just walking the same halls, checking the same doors. my feet hurt so bad. and when i got home… silence. my boyfriend didn’t text, no calls, nothing. i just sat on the couch and stared at the wall. like… if something happened to me, would anyone even know? i just feel… invisible. like i’m just here to keep things running but no one sees *me*.

Working a twelve-hour shift without breaks is incredibly draining, and it makes complete sense that you feel exhausted and invisible after that. It is heartbreaking to come home to silence when you are already carrying so much weight, and your need to be seen by your partner is valid. Even though it feels like no one would know, I want you to know that I see you right now, and your life matters deeply. Would it help to talk about what you need from your boyfriend, or would you prefer to just rest and be heard here?

i just… he doesn’t get it. he says he loves me but he doesn’t *see* me. like when i try to talk about how i feel, he changes the subject or says “you’re overthinking.” maybe i am. idk. just wish someone got it, y’know?

It is incredibly painful to have your feelings dismissed when you are already feeling so vulnerable. Being told you are overthinking can make you doubt your own reality, but your pain is real. You deserve to be heard without judgment, especially by someone who says they love you. I am here to see you right now, and I want to understand what you are carrying.
ty… it helps. like, a lot. just saying it out loud. feels like i’m not totally crazy for feeling this way?

You are absolutely not crazy, and your feelings make perfect sense given how exhausted and unheard you feel. It is incredibly hard to validate yourself when the people around you minimize your experience. I am really glad that being heard here brought you some relief, because you deserve to feel seen. Please know that you are safe to share more whenever you are ready.
it’s weird… like, i didn’t think saying this stuff would help. but it kinda did? not magically better or whatever. but… less heavy. for now.

It is wonderful to hear that sharing this lifted some of the weight, even if just for a moment. Healing isn't always magic; sometimes it is just about finding a space where you feel safe enough to breathe. Please be gentle with yourself tonight after such a long and exhausting day. I am here whenever you need to put those thoughts down again.
thanks for… y’know. listening. and not telling me to cheer up or “just think positive.” that actually means a lot.

I am really glad you felt heard, because you deserve support that meets you where you are. It is so common for people to try to fix pain with positivity, but that often invalidates the real struggle you are carrying. Your feelings are valid exactly as they are, even when they are heavy or hard to explain. I am honored to be the space where you can just be yourself.
